description.value: The Parkside Brewery is a craft brewery and tasting room on Port Moody's celebrated Brewer's Row, situated directly across from Rocky Point Park at the foot of Eagle Mountain. Beers are brewed on site with a regularly rotating lineup of award-winning ales, lagers, and IPAs, with cans and growler fills available to go. The front patio welcomes dogs, and food trucks are hosted outside on most days, making it a sociable stop at the head of Burrard Inlet.

address.value: 2731 Murray St, Port Moody, BC V3H 1X1

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 29m; stands (12 spaces) at 62m; stands (6 spaces) at 82m; stands (8 spaces) at 96m. Total: 26 spaces.
